review:
Epic Ze Zeus brings Hacksaw's comic Zeus back as an Epic version with a 50,000x max win. It is a cluster game: squares behind winning symbols become Divine Squares, and a Hand of Zeus symbol activates them to reveal Bronze, Silver or Gold coins worth multiples of the bet.

Zap of Zeus multiplies adjacent coins and Vessel of Wealth symbols by up to 10x, and Vessels collect every coin value on the grid. Three FS give 8 free spins where Divine Squares stay until used, and four give 12 spins where they stay even after activation. Five FS start the Epic Bonus with a Hand of Zeus on every spin and only Silver or Gold coins. Hacksaw lists 5/5 volatility and RTPs of 96.22%, 94.16% and 92.35%.
